{{Quote|It's not on our end.|Console tech to Attendant Felzonis|<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />}}
A [[human]] '''tech''' with light skin and [[color|red]] [[hair]] worked for the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] in [[2 BBY]]. [[ISB Attendant]] [[Felzonis]] enlisted<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> her<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion AD" /> help when the connection to a [[listening device]] in [[senator]] [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[Mon Mothma's Senate office|office]] was lost. After examining Felzonis's console in the [[Imperial Security Bureau control center]], she was able to determine it wasn't a problem on their end concluding it had to be on the senator's end. Unbeknownst to either of them, Mothma had smashed the device after her aid [[Erskin Semaj]] located it in her office. The tech wore a light gray [[Imperial officer's uniform]] with two blue pips on her [[rank insignia plaque]] and a black [[Imperial kepi]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The tech appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> Credited simply as "console tech", she was portrayed by [[Ezra England]] in the episode.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />
